exteriorDecor.comment: royal gardens — fountains, statues, bird baths, benches
hedges and ornamental bushes framing the gardens
rose beds (Queen's roses) and crops in the orangery yard
iron fencing along the south garden wall, gate gap on the avenue
lamp posts lining the grand approach and avenues
outer court — barrels, crates, sacks near the service buildings
servants' yard — washing line and well
notice board in the outer court
a quiet ornamental pond in the gardens

npcs.name: Steward Marigold
dialogue: Oh dear, oh dear. There is always something misplaced, misfiled, or misbehaving at this palace.
Their Majesties are in session. The gardens, however, receive all visitors.
If you've a strong back and a willing heart, the crown has no end of small disasters for you.

idle-chat: Oh dear, oh dear — always something misplaced at this palace.

npcs.name: Herald Fanshawe
dialogue: Presenting: you. To no one in particular. It's been a slow morning.
Hear ye, hear ye — the proclamations have gone missing again. A herald with no words is merely a man shouting.
Protocol is the art of standing in the right place while important things happen elsewhere.

idle-chat: Presenting: you. To no one in particular. Still a slow morning.
Protocol dictates I stand here looking important. It's working, I think.

npcs.name: Guardsman Brick
dialogue: Move along. Or stand there. You're not technically breaking any rules.
Nobody enters the throne room without an appointment. Or a mop. The mop people go everywhere.
Quietest post in the kingdom, this. I've counted the fence railings twice.

work: Move along. Or stand there. Either way, I'm watching.

npcs.name: King Aldric
dialogue: Ah, a new face. The court is forever full of old ones, all of them wanting something.
A crown is heavier than it looks, and most of the weight is other people's problems.
Serve the realm well and the realm remembers. Mostly. When it isn't distracted.

work: The court is in session. State your business, or admire the throne from a distance.

npcs.name: Queen Maredith
dialogue: Mind the roses on your way through the garden — they are the one thing here that answers to no one.
The King rules the realm; I rule the garden. We are each terrified of the other's domain.
A kingdom is judged by its kindnesses, not its conquests. Remember that, if you remember nothing else.

work: Court business, before the garden. The roses can wait a morning.
idle-chat: Mind the roses — they answer to no one, least of all a queen.

npcs.name: Princess Elara
dialogue: Have you news of Kipper? My dear, dear cat, sent to the seaside and wailing ever since. I cannot bear it.
Everyone says a princess should be content. I should be content the moment my cat is.
The goblin and the ogre by the fountain only wish to meet me. Steward Marigold won't allow it. Isn't that sad?

idle-chat: Do you think Kipper misses me as much as I miss him? Say yes.
The goblin and the ogre wave to me from the fountain. I wave back. Steward Marigold sighs.

npcs.name: Lady Penrose
dialogue: A guest of the crown, like yourself. Or perhaps not quite like yourself. I keep my purposes close.
Court is a garden of its own, dear. Every smile is a seed, and not all of them bloom kindly.
I have a small matter that wants a discreet hand. Are yours discreet?

npcs.name: Master Edric
dialogue: Every coin accounted for, that is the rule. The trouble is, the coins do not always agree.
The audit is overdue and the inner vault stays sealed until the ledgers balance.
Bring me the scattered tallies and I'll open the deep vault myself.

work: The vault stays sealed until the ledgers balance. Every coin, every time.
sleep: ...mmh... the tallies... don't add up... zzz...

npcs.sleepDialogue: ...mmh... the tallies... don't add up... zzz...

npcs.name: Brother Cassian
dialogue: Peace, traveller. The chapel is open to all, even the road-weary and the regicidal — though we prefer the former.
The crypt below holds kings long past. They keep their counsel well.
Our candles have a way of wandering off. A chapel without light is only a cold stone room.

work: Peace, traveller. Light a candle if you've a mind to.

npcs.name: Cook Bessie
dialogue: Out of my kitchen — unless you've come to help, in which case, in, in, in!
A royal feast does not cook itself, more's the pity. I've asked the cauldron. It just bubbles at me.
Fetch me what I need and the court eats like kings. Which, conveniently, they are.

work: Out of my kitchen, unless you're carrying something I asked for!

npcs.name: Gardener Thom
dialogue: Mind the beds, mind the beds! A boot in the begonias and I'll have words with you.
The Queen wants roses, the King wants order, and the rabbits want my lettuces. Everyone wants something.
If you've a good eye, there's a rare bloom or two I've lost track of out here.

work: Mind the beds! I only just got the begonias straightened out.

npcs.name: Stable-Master Garrod
dialogue: Easy, easy. The horses spook at strangers, and frankly, so do I.
One of the ponies slipped its tack and bolted half the gear across the grounds. Royal beasts, royal nuisance.
Help me round up the lost harness and there's coin in it for you.

work: Easy now — mind the stalls, the horses spook easy this morning.
sleep: ...mmh... the tack... put it back... zzz...

npcs.sleepDialogue: ...mmh... the tack... put it back... zzz...

npcs.name: Dave the Goblin
dialogue: Hello! We only want to MEET the princess. Is that so much to ask?

npcs.name: Nick the Ogre
dialogue: I'm here to see the princess, only she can help me!

npcs.name: Sir Galavant
dialogue: Hello!

npcs.name: Sir Gadabout
dialogue: Hello!

npcs.name: Master of Coin Aldric
dialogue: The crown's finest — kept safe in the annex until a worthy buyer comes along.
Every coin in this room has a ledger entry. Every sale, too.
The vault proper is for the king's treasures. This room is for yours.

reactions.text: An autumn-gold tree in the East Gardens, worth a closer look.
A patch of blue flowers growing between the garden's bird baths.
A tidy bush along the garden's far edge.

text: ROYAL PROCLAMATION: All subjects are reminded that the gardens are for strolling, not stampeding.
LOST: One ceremonial pendant, one jubilee gift, one vault key. Reward offered by the Steward.
NOTICE: The Princess's cat Kipper remains at Millhaven. Updates to follow.

reactions.text: Half-hidden beneath a rose bush in the royal gardens, something small glints in the dirt.

collectible.name: Garden Locket
collectible.desc: A small locket, its clasp long since rusted shut.
collectible.lore: Queen Maredith tends these gardens herself. If this is hers, she's never once mentioned losing it.

reactions.message: You found a small locket buried beneath the roses.

reactions.text: Pressed into the soil near the bird baths, a wax seal has hardened into a small disc.

collectible.name: Broken Wax Seal
collectible.desc: A disc of hardened wax, the royal crest pressed into one side, snapped clean in half.
collectible.lore: Herald Fanshawe would recognize this crest — it matches the missing proclamations he's still hunting for. Someone broke this seal in a hurry.

reactions.message: You found half of a broken wax seal.

reactions.text: Tucked behind a stack of crates in the servants' yard, a torn ledger page flutters.

collectible.name: Torn Ledger Scrap
collectible.desc: A scrap of a ledger page, the numbers smudged but the total still legible.
collectible.lore: Master Edric would want this back — 'every coin accounted for,' he always says. This page accounts for rather fewer coins than the vault claims to hold.

reactions.message: You found a torn scrap of ledger.

reactions.text: Behind the crates someone left blocking the avenue, a gilded chest sits forgotten against the wall.

collectible.name: Missing Vault Coin
collectible.desc: A small pouch of coins, exactly matching the shortfall on the torn ledger page.
collectible.lore: Master Edric's numbers were right after all. Someone just hid the difference rather than explain it.

reactions.message: You found the coins the ledger was missing!

animals.name: Baron
dialogue: *woof!*
The royal hound thumps his tail against the flagstones.

animals.name: Smoke
dialogue: *mrrp?*
A palace cat regards you with regal indifference.
